claims.hypothesis: Starless MDCs host high-mass pre-stellar cores (quasi-static models)
claims.finding: No high-mass pre-stellar cores; quasi-static models not supported

evidence.quote: These observations do not support the quasi-static models for high-mass star formation since no high-mass pre-stellar core is found in NGC6334.

claims.hypothesis: MDCs fragment as predicted by competitive accretion
claims.experiment: Compare detected cores with Jeans fragmentation expectation
claims.result: Few fragments, ~two orders of magnitude below prediction
claims.finding: Incompatible unless fragmentation has not yet begun

evidence.quote: We detected only a few fragments in our sample, two orders of magnitude below the predicted fragmentation level.

limitations_admitted.value: Interferometer filters out most emission; short-spacing data needed

evidence.quote: Combination with short-spacing observations is therefore mandatory to investigate the exact cloud structure of starless MDCs.
